Theme

scatter verb

classical

spargō, spargere

verb, third conjugation

Other words

  • dispergō, dispergere, dispersī, dispersum — scatter, disperse

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Varr. RR 2.3.9: caprae dispergunt sē (Lewis & Short)

  • disjiciō, disjicere, disjēcī, disjectum — throw apart, break up, scatter, rout

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Caes. BG 1.25.2: eā disjectā (Lewis & Short)

  • dissipō, dissipāre, dissipāvī, dissipātum — scatter, disperse; squander

    verb, first conjugation · also used · classical · Liv. 30.5: ignis tōtīs sē passim dissipāvit castrīs (Lewis & Short)

Examples

  • caprae dispergunt sē, contrā ovēs sē congregant et condēnsant in locum ūnum

    goats scatter, whereas sheep flock together and crowd into one placeVarr. RR 2.3.9 (Lewis & Short)

  • eā disjectā

    when it (the phalanx) had been broken upCaes. BG 1.25.2 (Lewis & Short)

  • ignis tōtīs sē passim dissipāvit castrīs

    the fire spread in all directions through the whole campLiv. 30.5 (Lewis & Short)
